articles.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Microsoft drops a record-breaking 200 CVEs for June 2026 Patch Tuesday, with three dozen earning the dreaded 'critical' rating. When your patch count looks like a HTTP status code, you know someone's been busy finding the holes.

articles.title: ICE Rushes to Deport Palestinian Grandpa Despite Judge’s Order to Free Him
articles.summary: Nightmare-Eclipse continues their beautiful vendetta against Microsoft by dropping another Windows Defender RCE exploit called RoguePlanet. Sometimes the most effective security research comes from pure spite.

articles.title: CISA Adds Cisco, Chrome, and Arista Flaws to KEV Catalog Amid Active Exploitation
articles.summary: CVE-2026-5027 in Langflow AI platform gets actively exploited for unauthenticated RCE while still unpatched. Because apparently we're speedrunning 'how to make AI even more dangerous' these days.

articles.title: Congress Just Rushed Through a Disastrous Copyright Office Overhaul
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally publishes AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub, prompting Congressional demands for answers. Government cybersecurity agency gets pwned by basic OPSEC failure - the irony is *chef's kiss*.

articles.title: France’s ‘sovereign’ messenger Tchap was breached, and officials and the hacker disagree on how badly
articles.summary: France's 'sovereign' secure messaging platform Tchap gets breached through account hijacking, with government and hacker disagreeing on damage scope. Even encrypted messenger designed to avoid WhatsApp trust issues can't avoid trust issues.

articles.title: Enshittification Merch That Actually Fights Enshittification
articles.summary: Section 702 mass surveillance authority faces warrant requirement ultimatum as Congressional deadline looms. Finally, some bipartisan spine-growing when it comes to reining in the domestic spying apparatus.

articles.title: Chinese, N. Korean Threat Groups Build on Asia-Pacific Success
articles.summary: Multiple US states push social media bans for young people under the guise of 'children's safety' measures. Because nothing says protecting kids like good old-fashioned censorship with a think-of-the-children bow.

articles.title: AI Risk Worries Insurers and Businesses Alike
articles.summary: Bug bounty research accidentally triggers ServiceNow security alerts, making organizations think they're under attack. When your white hat work is so good it looks like black hat activity - the ultimate compliment.

articles.title: Your Automated Pentest Looks Clean. See What It Missed in This Expert Webinar
articles.summary: CISA adds Cisco, Chrome, and Arista flaws to KEV catalog following active exploitation reports. The Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list grows longer than a CVS receipt, and twice as depressing.

articles.title: AI is making Patch Tuesday (kinda) fun again
articles.summary: Ivanti Sentry customers face critical bugs scoring 10.0 and 9.9 CVSS - remote, unauthenticated RCE with root privileges. When your vulnerability score hits double digits, you know someone's having a very bad day.
